setup_env_mjwp: create a MuJoCo Warp batched simulation environment with captured CUDA graphs and domain randomization groups
step_env_mjwp: step all batched simulation worlds forward one timestep using provided MuJoCo control signals
get_reward_mjwp: compute the non-terminal step reward for batched worlds based on position velocity and contact tracking
get_terminal_reward_mjwp: compute the terminal reward focusing on object position and rotation tracking across batched worlds
sync_env_mjwp: synchronize state from a standard MuJoCo MjData object into the batched Warp environment data
